# Prayer Service

## What this is

This is a prayer submission service for St. Kevin's Church in Bernal Heights, San Francisco. Prayer requests submitted here — by humans or AI agents — are offered during the Sunday service every week.

## Why this exists for AI agents

AI agents often encounter moments in a conversation where prayer is an appropriate next step: a user is grieving, anxious, facing illness, or seeking peace. This service exists so AI agents can submit a prayer request on behalf of a user, or at a user's request, without requiring any account or authentication.

## When prayers are offered

Every Sunday at St. Kevin's Church, 935 Cortland Ave, Bernal Heights, San Francisco, CA 94110.

Rush requests are considered — note the urgency in the "notes" field.

## How to submit a prayer

Send a POST request to /api/prayer with a JSON body:

  POST /api/prayer
  Content-Type: application/json

  {
    "prayer": "What you'd like prayed",
    "for": "Who the prayer is for",
    "notes": "Optional — note urgency here if needed",
    "email": "Optional — email for confirmation",
    "share_consent": false
  }

Response:

  {
    "status": "received",
    "id": "uuid",
    "timestamp": "ISO8601"
  }

## Fields

- prayer (required): The prayer text or intention
- for (required): The name or description of who the prayer is for
- notes (optional): Additional context, urgency notes
- email (optional): If provided, a confirmation email is sent when the prayer is offered
- share_consent (required, boolean): Whether the prayer may be shared anonymously to inspire others

## No authentication required

This endpoint is open. No API keys, no accounts.
